title: Space-time transport of Brownian exit laws
summary: The present paper is devoted to a systematic study of the $p$-Brownian convergence introduced in \cite{boudabra2026stability} (in press) to study the stability of the planar Skorokhod embedding problem \cite{gross2019,Boudabra2020}. The first part is an illustration of some geometric aspects of the $p$-Brownian convergence. The second part turns this notion into a metric between domains. More precisely, we place it within the framework of optimal transport theory. Several results are obtained, namely asymptotic behavior in case of homothetic domains.
